events.text: Platzeck co-founded ARGUS, a Potsdam environmental organization, with Carola Schmidt.
events.subject: self
events.quote: Platzeck co-founded ARGUS , a Potsdam environmental organization , with and at the initiative of Carola Schmidt in April 1988 .

events.text: Platzeck joined the Liberal Democratic Party of Germany.
events.subject: self
events.quote: In April 1989 , he joined the Liberal Democratic Party of Germany

events.text: Platzeck left the Liberal Democratic Party of Germany shortly thereafter.
events.subject: self
events.quote: he joined the Liberal Democratic Party of Germany but left it shortly thereafter

events.text: Platzeck represented ARGUS at the founding of the Grüne Liga association of local environmental organizations in East Germany.
events.subject: self
events.quote: He represented ARGUS at the founding of the Grüne Liga association of local environmental organizations in East Germany in November 1989 .

events.text: Platzeck was their speaker at the East German Round Table talks during the political Wende.
events.subject: self
events.quote: During the political Wende of 1989–1990 that led to German Reunification he was their speaker at the East German Round Table talks .

events.text: Platzeck represented the oppositional radical Green Party as Minister without Portfolio.
events.subject: self
events.quote: From February to April 1990 he represented the oppositional radical Green Party as Minister without Portfolio

events.text: Platzeck's term as Minister without Portfolio ended.
events.subject: self
events.quote: From February to April 1990 he represented the oppositional radical Green Party as Minister without Portfolio

events.text: Platzeck was elected member of the Volkskammer for the Green Party.

events.quote: Platzeck was elected member of the Volkskammer in 1990 for the Green Party

events.text: Platzeck became a member of the Landtag of Brandenburg for Bündnis 90.
events.subject: self
events.quote: In October 1990 Platzeck became a member of the Landtag of Brandenburg for Bündnis 90 ( Alliance 90 ) .

events.text: Platzeck became Minister for the Environment in a coalition government with the SPD and FDP.
events.subject: self
events.quote: He was Minister for the Environment in a coalition government with the SPD and FDP from 1990 to 1994

events.text: The coalition broke up, ending Platzeck's post as Minister for the Environment.

events.quote: from 1990 to 1994 , when the coalition broke up

events.text: Platzeck did not join the new party Bündnis 90/Die Grünen.

events.text: Platzeck became a member of the SPD.
events.subject: self
events.quote: Instead , he became a member of the SPD on 6 June 1995 .

events.text: Platzeck left his faction after the break of the Brandenburg coalition.
events.subject: self
events.quote: After the break of the Brandenburg coalition in 1994 Platzeck left his faction

events.text: Platzeck became popular nationwide for organizing public support for the affected population during a flood of the Oder river.
events.subject: self
events.quote: He became popular nationwide for organizing public support for the affected population during a flood of the Oder river in 1997 .

events.text: Platzeck was elected mayor of Brandenburgs capital Potsdam.
events.subject: self
events.quote: In 1998 he was elected mayor of Brandenburgs capital Potsdam

events.text: Platzeck was elected chairman of the SPD in Brandenburg.

events.quote: In 2000 Platzeck was elected chairman of the SPD in Brandenburg

events.text: Platzeck succeeded Manfred Stolpe as Minister-president.

events.text: Platzeck was re-elected to the Landtag.

events.quote: He was re-elected to the Landtag ( state parliament ) in 2004 .

events.text: Platzeck served as President of the Bundesrat.

events.quote: He served as President of the Bundesrat in 2004/05 .
